Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Starships of the Galaxy

STARSHIP ARMOR EMPLACEMENT POINTS AVAILABILITY SIZE RESTRICTION COST
+1 2 Licensed - 2000 (Base)
+2 5 Restricted Colossal or Larger 5000 (Base)
+3 10 Military Colossal (Frigate) or Larger 10000 (Base)
+4 20 Military Colossal (Frigate) or Larger 20000 (Base)

A basic level of armor exists in all Starships- it's a necessary part of building a hull strong enough to survive the rigors of space- and Starship Armor never has to be completely replaced, just patched up. However, it's possible to add additional armor beyond what's needed to keep a Starship inact while traveling through Hyperspace, and doing so can boost a ship's chance of making it out of a firefight. Additional Starship Armor is heavy and generally obvious, giving a Starship a blocky, military appearance. Starship Armor is bought as an Equipment bonus to the Armor a Starship adds to it's Reflex Defense. Skilled pilots often prefer ships without heavy armor, since they can use their Character Level in place of a ship's Armor bonus in any case.
